official_alert.headline: Modified Bus Schedules: Thanksgiving to President’s Day
official_alert.description: Due to adjusted school schedules between Thanksgiving and President’s Day, select bus routes operate on modified schedules between November 2026 and February 2027.

official_alert.headline: Sunday Schedule in Effect for Thanksgiving Day
official_alert.description: Bus, Metro and Regional Rail routes operate on a Sunday schedule on Thanksgiving Day. Routes that do not have Sunday schedules do not operate. All modes resume regular weekday schedule at the start of service day, Friday, November 27.
